facts.fact: Banco Nacional de Angola Aviso n.º 4/25 of 22 August 2025, made under article 6 of Lei n.º 40/20 (Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola), sets binding rules for opening, operating and closing e-money accounts by payment service providers that issue e-money, in force from publication.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola (Lei n.º 40/20)
